author: Sarah M.
text: Absolutely incredible Safari Blue experience. The marine park fee was included upfront - no surprise charges on the beach. Our guide was knowledgeable and the fresh seafood lunch was the best meal of our Zanzibar trip.
serviceName: Safari Blue / Menai Bay Dhow Day

author: James T.
text: Airport transfer to Nungwi was seamless. Driver was waiting with a name board, flight was tracked, and the van was clean and air-conditioned. Zero deposit required - paid on arrival. Will book again.
serviceName: ZNZ Airport to Nungwi / Kendwa Transfer

author: Maria S.
text: Stone Town walking tour with a licensed local guide was the highlight of our trip. The guide knew every carved door and spice alley. Transparent pricing, no haggling. Highly recommend Spice & Sail.

author: David R.
text: Mnemba Atoll snorkeling was magical. Saw turtles and dolphins. The $25 marine fee was clearly included in the price - no cash demands on the boat. Professional crew and great equipment.

author: Elena V.
text: Jozani Forest tour to see the red colobus monkeys was educational and fun. Our guide explained the conservation work. Transfer from our hotel in Paje was on time and professional.

author: Thomas W.
text: Safari Blue was a long day but worth it. The sandbank at low tide was stunning. Only suggestion: more shade on the boat. Otherwise excellent value with marine fees included.
serviceName: Safari Blue / Menai Bay Dhow Day

author: Amina K.
text: Local operator with real Zanzibari guides. Booked a private transfer to Paje and a spice farm tour. Fair prices, punctual service, and the team speaks excellent English and Swahili.
serviceName: ZNZ Airport to Paje & Jambiani Transfer

author: Lisa M.
text: The Island Stonetown hotel booking was seamless through Spice & Sail. Verified rates, no surprise hotel tax, and airport transfer was included in our package. Great communication via WhatsApp.
